name: ACID FAST BACILLI STAIN
ssx: Coughing: A cough that lasts three weeks or longer, or coughing up blood or phlegm, Chest pain: Pain in the chest, Weight loss: Unexplained weight loss, also known as `consumption`, Fever: A high temperature, Night sweats: Sweating at night, Fatigue: Feeling tired all day, Loss of appetite: Not feeling hungry
preparation: typically no special preparation is needed; the patient simply needs to provide a specimen, usually sputum (mucus coughed up from the lungs), which will be used to create a smear on a microscope slide for staining and analysis; the healthcare provider will instruct on proper collection methods to ensure a quality
procedure: apply a thin smear of the specimen to a clean slide, heat fix it, flood with primary stain (carbolfuchsin), decolorize with acid alcohol, counterstain with methylene blue, rinse, and air dry; the key step is the decolorization with acid alcohol, which allows only acid-fast bacteria to retain the primary stain color.
